titre: Le grand frère qui travaille au Plateau
lieu: esplanade at the foot of a tall glass office tower in Plateau, Abidjan, a concrete bench, other office towers behind, midday sun

persos.desc: young man around 20, saffron-and-lilac t-shirt, skinny with a hopeful grin, empty hands
persos.pose: standing on the left, hands pressed together, begging

persos.nom: the big brother with the badge
persos.desc: man in his 30s, olive-and-cream suit, an office badge on a lanyard, tired eyes, holding ONE single leather briefcase
persos.pose: standing in the foreground on the right, turned three-quarters to the camera, briefcase in one hand, the glass tower behind him

dialogue: Grand frère, prête-moi cent mille dêh ! Tu travailles au Plateau !
Mon petit, au Plateau, c'est l'immeuble qui est haut. Pas le salaire-là.
jeu: Nobody walks; both stay in their places for the whole video. The little brother begs with his hands pressed together, then points one finger up at the tall tower. The big brother sighs, points his free hand up at the tower too without moving his feet, then lowers it and says the last line flatly, his face clearly visible.
chute: The little brother's hopeful grin slowly collapses. The camera slowly pushes in to a close-up of the big brother's weary deadpan face looking into the camera.
gag_legende: LES GENS DU PLATEAU LE 25 DU MOIS :
mecanisme: retournement logique à double cible : le prestige des tours du Plateau et le petit salaire de celui qui y travaille

lieu: small cement courtyard of a house in Attécoubé, Abidjan, two plastic chairs, a low table, a view of the lagoon behind a low wall, late afternoon

persos.nom: the borrower with the old phone
persos.desc: man in his 30s, maroon-and-salmon tracksuit, thin moustache, holding ONE single old cracked smartphone
persos.pose: standing on the left, holding the cracked phone out toward the lender, smiling proudly

persos.desc: man in his 30s, peach-and-sky-blue shirt, round face, arms crossed
persos.pose: standing in the foreground on the right, turned three-quarters to the camera, arms crossed, frowning at the phone

dialogue: Prête-moi cinquante mille dêh. Je laisse mon téléphone en garantie.
Ton téléphone-là vaut pas cinq mille !
Je sais. C'est le tien. Tu me l'as prêté l'an passé.
jeu: Nobody walks; both stay in their places for the whole video. The borrower holds out the cracked phone with a confident smile. The lender, arms crossed, looks at the phone with disgust and scoffs. The borrower shrugs calmly, still holding out the phone, and says the last line, his face clearly visible.
chute: The lender's arms drop and he stares at the phone, mouth wide open. The camera slowly pushes in to a close-up of the lender's stunned face looking into the camera.
gag_legende: QUAND TU RECONNAIS TON TÉLÉPHONE :
mecanisme: retournement logique à double cible : le prêteur insulte son propre téléphone, l'emprunteur avoue un ancien prêt jamais rendu

lieu: office of a bank branch manager in Plateau, Abidjan, a wide desk seen from the side with a computer and a loan file, large windows showing office towers, morning

persos.desc: man in his 30s, violet-and-sunflower shirt, nervous smile, holding ONE single cardboard folder on his knees
persos.pose: seated on a chair at the left end of the desk, in the foreground, turned three-quarters to the camera

persos.desc: branch manager in his 30s, emerald-and-cherry suit, rectangular glasses, calm smile
persos.pose: seated behind the desk on the right, both hands flat on the loan file

dialogue: Mon vieux, c'est toi le directeur ?!
Oui. Tu me dois cent mille depuis l'université.
Ya fohi ! Donc mon crédit-là est accordé ?
Accordé. Cent mille. Directement sur mon compte dêh.
jeu: Nobody walks; both stay in their places for the whole video. The borrower points at the manager in happy surprise. The manager nods calmly and taps the loan file once with one finger. The borrower raises his eyebrows with a hopeful grin. The manager smiles wider and says the last line, his face clearly visible.
chute: The borrower's hopeful grin freezes and his shoulders sink. The camera slowly pushes in to a close-up of the hopeful borrower's crushed face looking into the camera.
gag_legende: QUAND LA BANQUE TE CONNAÎT DÉJÀ :
mecanisme: retournement logique à double cible : le crédit accordé rembourse la vieille dette, l'emprunteur repart sans rien et doit maintenant à la banque

persos.desc: mother in her 30s, fuchsia-and-silver kaba, headscarf, worried eyebrows, holding ONE single folded banknote
persos.pose: sitting on the sofa on the left, leaning toward her son, holding out the folded banknote

persos.desc: boy around 10, rose-and-cyan t-shirt, big round eyes, sly smile, hands behind his back
persos.pose: standing in the foreground on the right, turned three-quarters to the camera, hands behind his back

dialogue: Mon fils, faut pas dire à papa que je dois l'argent à la voisine dêh.

jeu: Nobody walks; both stay in their places for the whole video. The mother whispers urgently, glancing at the closed door, holding out the folded banknote. The boy does not take it; he tilts his head with a sly smile and says the last line, his face clearly visible.
chute: The mother freezes, mouth wide open, the banknote still in her hand. The camera slowly pushes in to a close-up of the sly boy's smug face looking into the camera.
gag_legende: LA VOISINE EN FAISANT SES COMPTES :
mecanisme: retournement logique à double cible : papa et maman doivent en cachette à la même voisine, et l'enfant encaisse des deux côtés

lieu: front door of a small house in Port-Bouët, Abidjan, a sandy yard, a wooden stool, coconut palms and the sea in the distance, morning

persos.pose: standing on the left near the door, notebook raised, angry

persos.desc: wife in her 40s, olive-and-cream boubou, unimpressed look, hands on her hips
persos.pose: standing in the doorway in the middle, hands on her hips

persos.nom: the lazy husband on the stool
persos.desc: husband in his 40s, saffron-and-lilac polo shirt, round belly, holding ONE single small transistor radio
persos.pose: sitting on the wooden stool in the foreground on the right, turned three-quarters to the camera, relaxed, radio on his knee

dialogue: Madame, ton mari-là me doit deux cent mille dêh !
Ya fohi. Prends-le alors, mon vieux.

jeu: Nobody walks; all three stay in their places for the whole video. The creditor shakes his notebook angrily toward the wife. The wife, hands on her hips, nods her chin toward her husband on the stool. The creditor glances at the husband, horrified, and throws his free hand up. The wife answers calmly, hands on her hips, her face clearly visible. The husband keeps smiling at his little radio the whole time, unaware.
chute: The husband's smile slowly fades as he finally understands. The camera slowly pushes in to a close-up of the lazy husband's offended face looking into the camera.
gag_legende: LE MARI QUAND IL A COMPRIS :
mecanisme: retournement logique à double cible : le mari ne vaut rien comme gage, et le créancier découvre le calvaire de l'épouse

persos.desc: boy around 11, peach-and-sky-blue t-shirt, short hair, innocent curious face

chute: The father's raised finger freezes in the air and his proud expression dies. The camera slowly pushes in to a close-up of the lecturing father's busted face looking into the camera.
gag_legende: PAPA EN CHERCHANT UNE RÉPONSE :
mecanisme: retournement logique à double cible : la leçon de papa révèle qu'il a emprunté à maman et qu'il a perdu l'argent et la femme

chute: The adviser slowly lowers the contract, speechless. The camera slowly pushes in to a close-up of the client's hopeful, delighted face looking into the camera.
gag_legende: LA BELLE-MÈRE QUAND ELLE VA APPRENDRE ÇA :
mecanisme: retournement logique à double cible : la menace de saisie devient une bonne nouvelle, la banque et la belle-mère visées d'un coup

gag_legende: MADAME APRÈS CETTE RÉPONSE :
mecanisme: retournement logique à double cible : la moitié de dot impayée se règle en rendant la moitié bavarde, le beau-père et l'épouse visés

persos.pose: standing on the left behind the table, ladle in hand, furious

gag_legende: LA BELLE-SŒUR QUAND ELLE VA ENTENDRE ÇA :

persos.desc: wife in her 30s, saffron-and-lilac kaba, headscarf, one eyebrow raised, holding ONE single phone
persos.pose: standing on the left, holding her phone, suspicious

persos.desc: husband in his 40s, maroon-and-salmon shirt, round belly, proud chin

gag_legende: TOUS LES PATRONS D'ABIDJAN EN VOYANT ÇA :
mecanisme: retournement logique à double cible : le titre de patron vient de ses dettes, et les vrais patrons qui ne paient pas sont visés

persos.desc: man in his 40s, peach-and-sky-blue tracksuit, angry eyebrows, short grey hair

persos.desc: man in his 30s, violet-and-sunflower t-shirt, big grin, gap between his front teeth

dialogue: Mon vieux, rembourse mes cinquante mille aujourd'hui même !

chute: The creditor's pointing finger slowly drops, his mouth hanging open. The camera slowly pushes in to a close-up of the creditor's stunned face looking into the camera.
gag_legende: LE MARI EN RENTRANT À LA MAISON :
mecanisme: retournement logique à double cible : le créancier sera remboursé avec l'argent que sa propre femme lui cache

lieu: terrace of a small café in Plateau, Abidjan, a round table with three glasses of juice, office towers in the background, afternoon

persos.desc: man in his 30s, emerald-and-cherry shirt, slick haircut, proud smile
persos.pose: standing on the left, one open hand presenting his fiancée

persos.desc: young woman in her 20s, fuchsia-and-silver dress, long braids, a small handbag on her arm
persos.pose: standing in the middle next to him, smiling politely

persos.desc: man in his 30s, rose-and-cyan polo shirt, short beard, hand extended for a handshake
persos.pose: standing in the foreground on the right, turned three-quarters to the camera, hand extended

dialogue: Mon vieux, je te présente ma fiancée dêh !
Chéri, c'est lui qui te doit cent mille-là ?
C'est moi je lui dois ?!
Rembourse vite, Tonton. C'est pour ma dot dêh.
jeu: Nobody walks; all three stay in their places for the whole video. The debtor proudly presents his fiancée with one open hand. The fiancée smiles and points at the creditor, delighted. The creditor, his extended hand frozen, points at his own chest in disbelief. The fiancée tilts her head sweetly and says the last line, her face clearly visible, while the debtor looks up at the sky.
chute: The creditor's extended hand slowly drops. The camera slowly pushes in to a close-up of the creditor friend's flabbergasted face looking into the camera.
gag_legende: QUAND TU FINANCES LA DOT DE TON DÉBITEUR :
mecanisme: révélation par un tiers : le débiteur a inversé la dette auprès de sa fiancée, et le créancier doit maintenant payer la dot

lieu: arrivals hall of the airport in Port-Bouët, Abidjan, a metal barrier, a luggage trolley with ONE single big suitcase, bright ceiling lights, night

persos.desc: man in his 40s, rose-and-cherry boubou, thick eyebrows, arms crossed
persos.pose: standing in the foreground on the left behind the metal barrier, turned three-quarters to the camera, arms crossed

persos.desc: man in his 30s, olive-and-cream tracksuit, sunglasses resting on top of his head, big smile, one hand on the luggage trolley
persos.pose: standing on the right behind the trolley, one hand on its handle

dialogue: Mon vieux, tu as ramené mes deux cent mille ?

Venir faire quoi ici ?!
Tu voulais voir ton argent. Me voilà dêh.
jeu: Nobody walks; both stay in their places for the whole video. The creditor asks, arms crossed, behind the barrier. The cousin pats the suitcase on the trolley with a big smile. The creditor uncrosses his arms and throws one hand up. The cousin lets go of the trolley, spreads both arms wide like a gift and says the last line, his face clearly visible.
chute: The creditor's hand drops and he stares at his cousin, mouth open. The camera slowly pushes in to a close-up of the waiting creditor's stunned face looking into the camera.
gag_legende: QUAND TON ARGENT REVIENT EN PERSONNE :
mecanisme: logique absurde : l'argent prêté est devenu un billet d'avion, et le débiteur se présente lui-même comme l'argent

lieu: courtyard of a house in Attécoubé, Abidjan, a charcoal stove with a big pot of sauce, a small table with plates, an empty plastic chair, noon

persos.desc: man in his 50s, maroon-and-salmon boubou, grey goatee, hands on his hips
persos.pose: standing in the foreground on the left, turned three-quarters to the camera, hands on his hips

persos.desc: man in his 30s, saffron-and-lilac shirt, friendly grin, holding ONE single wooden ladle
persos.pose: standing on the right next to the stove and the big pot, ladle in hand

dialogue: Rembourse mes cinquante mille aujourd'hui même dêh !
Ya fohi, Tonton. Assieds-toi, mange d'abord.
Je veux pas manger, je veux mon argent !
Tonton, ton argent-là est dans la sauce dêh.
jeu: Nobody walks; both stay in their places for the whole video. The creditor shouts, hands on his hips. The debtor smiles and points the ladle toward the empty plastic chair. The creditor shakes his head angrily. The debtor calmly points the ladle at the big pot of sauce and says the last line, his face clearly visible.
chute: The creditor stares at the pot, his anger melting into confusion and hunger. The camera slowly pushes in to a close-up of the old creditor's torn, tempted face looking into the camera.
gag_legende: LE TONTON QUAND IL SENT LA SAUCE :
mecanisme: retournement de situation : le remboursement est déjà dans la marmite, refuser le repas c'est refuser son argent

lieu: street corner in Port-Bouët, Abidjan, in front of a small phone-credit kiosk, a wooden bench, sandy ground, afternoon

persos.desc: man in his 40s, peach-and-sky-blue boubou, stern face, square jaw

persos.desc: man in his 30s, violet-and-sunflower tracksuit, eager face, skinny
persos.pose: standing in the middle between the two, nodding

persos.desc: man in his 30s, emerald-and-cherry tracksuit, calm sly smile, arms crossed
persos.pose: standing on the right, arms crossed

dialogue: Je t'ai pas prêté cinquante mille-là ?! Koffi était là !

Ah… Moi j'ai rien vu dêh.

chute: The creditor slowly turns his head toward Koffi, betrayed. The camera slowly pushes in to a close-up of the betrayed creditor's outraged face looking into the camera.
gag_legende: QUAND TON SEUL TÉMOIN A DES DETTES :
mecanisme: retournement du témoin : une petite dette achète le silence du témoin, le créancier perd sa seule preuve

persos.desc: boy around 9, fuchsia-and-silver t-shirt, chubby cheeks, angry face, hands on his hips
persos.pose: standing in the foreground on the left, turned three-quarters to the camera, hands on his hips

persos.desc: boy around 9, rose-and-cyan shirt, a school backpack on his shoulders, calm serious face, arms crossed

dialogue: Mon vieux, rembourse mes deux cents francs dêh !

chute: The lending boy's hands fall from his hips while he silently does the math. The camera slowly pushes in to a close-up of the lending boy's stunned face looking into the camera.
gag_legende: LE PAPA QUAND IL VA APPRENDRE ÇA :
mecanisme: logique d'enfant à double cible : le petit emprunt de récré devient le recouvrement de la dette du père

persos.desc: young man in his 20s, olive-and-cream shirt, embarrassed smile, one hand scratching the back of his head

dialogue: Mon fils, ton ami-là a remboursé ?

chute: The mother's triumphant smile freezes and the spoon slowly lowers. The camera slowly pushes in to a close-up of the mother's horrified face looking into the camera.
gag_legende: MAMAN EN OUVRANT SA CACHETTE :
mecanisme: retournement par révélation : la mère triomphe de son bon conseil, puis découvre que la victime c'est elle

gag_legende: LES INVITÉS QUI ONT DONNÉ CINQ MILLE :
mecanisme: retournement logique à double cible : la dette effacée devient le plus gros cadeau, et tous les autres invités radins sont visés

gag_legende: LE MARI QUAND SA FEMME VA RENTRER :

dialogue: Mon vieux, envoie-moi cinq cents d'unités dêh !
